title: CAS II: Symmetric Partitions as Kolmogorov Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.40290v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In algorithmic statistics a string x is explained by a finite set containing it, and Kolmogorov's structure function records the smallest such model at each level of complexity. Vereshchagin's strong models, those computable from the data by a total algorithm, are essentially the cells of simple partitions. We read a partition of binary strings as a hypothesis, with the cell containing x as its model, and develop algorithmic statistics over symmetric partitions: the orbit partitions of groups acting on strings. The Galois connection between subgroups and partitions gives each ambient group a lattice of symmetric partitions, with canonical certificates, canonical costs, and an algebra of hypotheses. The resulting structure function and symmetric sophistication measure which part of the regularity of x is symmetric. For the full symmetric group every partition is symmetric: cells recover all Kolmogorov models, cells of cheap partitions r

translated_title: CAS II：作为柯尔莫哥洛夫模型的对称划分
translated_abstract: 在算法统计学中，一个字符串 x 由包含它的有限集合来解释，而柯尔莫哥洛夫结构函数记录了在每个复杂度水平上最小的此类模型。Vereshchagin 的强模型（即可以通过全函数算法从数据中计算出的那些模型）本质上就是简单划分的单元。我们将二进制字符串上的划分解读为一个假设，把包含 x 的单元作为其模型，并基于对称划分——即作用在字符串上的群的轨道划分——发展算法统计学。子群与划分之间的伽罗瓦连接为每个环境群给出了一个对称划分的格，具有规范证书、规范代价以及假设的代数运算。由此得到的结构函数与对称复杂度衡量了 x 的规律性中哪一部分是对称的。对于全对称群，每个划分都是对称的：其单元恢复了所有柯尔莫哥洛夫模型，而廉价划分的单元……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将群作用的对称划分作为算法统计学中的假设与柯尔莫哥洛夫模型，利用子群与划分之间的伽罗瓦连接构建了对称划分格及其规范证书与代价体系，并通过对称结构函数和对称复杂度来度量字符串规律性中的对称成分。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes symmetric partitions (orbit partitions of group actions on strings) as hypotheses in algorithmic statistics, using the Galois connection between subgroups and partitions to build lattices of symmetric models with canonical certificates and costs, and introduces symmetric structure functions and sophistication to measure the symmetric component of a string's regularity.
